description: workflow/03_official_umfi.smk (experiment B): comparison with the official UMFI-LR code. Criteria are fixed here and in docs/experiment_plan.md before the run.

structural.perturbation: x -> 100 * x + 7 on the assessment rows

criteria.B1_gate_fired: max |official residual column - sharedimp residual column| <= tolerance when both are computed from the same rows
criteria.B1_gate_not_fired: the official column equals the raw column exactly (the difference to sharedimp is reported, not checked)
criteria.B2: same column names in the same order; anchor column equal to the raw anchor exactly; Reduced equals Full without the anchor column
criteria.B3: official importance and the official scoring rule applied to sharedimp's representations (same seed, same call order) differ by <= tolerance on the data set where every gate fires
criteria.B5a: the training representation that sharedimp passes to the learner is bit-identical after perturbing the assessment rows
criteria.B5b: the step-by-step fold-internal pipeline reproduces shared_importance() within tolerance
reported_only: B3 on the contrast data set
B5b size of the all-rows effect
